top_reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Perfect Fit and So Much Storage
top_reviews.body: This silverware organizer is exactly what I needed. It’s very spacious and fits all of my utensils with room to spare. I love that it’s expandable, which made it easy to adjust to my drawer size without any issues.The compartments are well designed and keep everything neatly separated, so my drawer finally looks organized instead of cluttered. It feels sturdy, not flimsy, and the quality is better than I expected.Overall, this is a great purchase and worth it if you have a lot of utensils or larger drawers. I would definitely buy this again and recommend it to anyone looking to upgrade their kitchen organization.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on February 22, 2026

top_reviews.title: Great product and great value!
top_reviews.body: We have a wide silverware drawer and I've struggled for years finding the right organizer.  When I discovered this one, I think my search is over!Pros: This one is expandable, which met my top need.  I was able to make it wide enough to take up the width of the drawer.With the 5 main slots, I have places for my different sized spoons and forks, as well as knives.  The long slots on the sides are great for bigger knives and can openers.  There are also slots at the top and bottom.  It's sturdier than I expected,  another plus.  It will also be easy to clean.Con: while it is wide and spacious,  I wish it were a little longer so it would take up my whole drawer,  but that's not a deal breaker by any means!  It may be too big for a standard drawer, so pay attention to measurements.Versatility: I may order more to organize my desk at school  and my bathroom drawer.Overall, this was a great value for the price and I'm thrilled with this product.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 26, 2026

top_reviews.title: Looks good, fits a lot.  Sides expand.
top_reviews.body: This silverware organizer fit my drawer perfectly front to back and side to side.  I love that it's expandable side to side so it would fit.  My old one left lots of space on 1 side that things would hide in and work their way under the organizer.  This fixes all that.The grey color looks much better than the white one it replaced.It easily fit all of my silverware.Well made, the sides are a bit hare to slide out, but that's what you want.  Once you have it sized correctly, you don't want it to move around.

top_reviews.title: GREAT!
top_reviews.body: i absolutely love  this. It is able to adjust to the size you need and however many sections you need. My silverware holder was short and kept sliding up and down. I hated it. And there was not enough dividers in it. This is what i bought to replace it. You can get different colors of your choosing. It can be used many different ways to fit your needs. It is lightweight plastic, but it is not like you need it to hold a mixer! It is made well enough for what you are using it for and awesome for the price you pay. I would definitely buy another one. Actually, i have bought a couple more, they were just a little different in style for smaller spaces cause this one is pretty large. Super easy to adjust. You cannot go wrong. I highly recommend. definitely organized my drawer. The kids just throw things in there everywhere, they didn't care. haha. This helped that problem immensely!!
